correctness.rationale: Deck-transform minimization gives A^2=T^2+(Y-Yprime)^2 and B^2=(2s-T)^2+(Y+Yprime)^2 under a common area-coordinate coupling; cylinder=A and Möbius=min(A,B), with T uniform on [0,s]. The linear (u,v) transform has density 1/(8h^2) on |u|+|v|<=2h, so integration of B<=r<A yields the claimed one-dimensional excess CDF and strict interval s<r<R. Opening t=s-w yields sqrt window coefficient 2sqrt(2)/(3h sqrt(s)); near R the event is the cylinder corner tail R^3/(48h^4s^2) eps^3. Independent Simpson/quadrature at s=1,h=.7 and 2 checked onset scaling trend; strict-shortcut probability follows from product of independent uniform magnitudes and has the stated smoothness break. Formula is for intrinsic flat quotient, not embedded ribbon.
